StatDef.label: service quality
StatDef.description: How pleasant this person is to be served by. Added to the satisfaction of guests they chat with.

StatDef.label: hosting learning
StatDef.description: Multiplier on the social experience gained while hosting guests.

StatDef.label: guest expectation
StatDef.description: Added to what a guest expects from a stay. Positive means harder to please. A refined palate raises a guest's own expectation; a silver-tongued host lowers it for the guests they welcome or show around.

StatDef.label: gambling joy
StatDef.description: Multiplier on the joy this person draws from gambling.

StatDef.label: gambling addiction chance
StatDef.description: Multiplier on the chance that gambling becomes an addiction. Zero means this person never gets hooked.

StatDef.label: sleight of hand
StatDef.description: Dealing speed as a croupier: rounds at their table are 3 % shorter per point (at most 30 %).

StatDef.label: card sense
StatDef.description: Intellectual levels added when this person plays blackjack or poker.

StatDef.label: watchfulness
StatDef.description: While this person is on the map, the chance that a respectable guest stumbles on the back room is divided by this. The most watchful colonist counts.

StatDef.label: brawl risk around them
StatDef.description: Multiplier on the chance that a quarrel in this person's room turns into a fistfight. The lowest value nearby counts.

StatDef.label: rumour spread
StatDef.description: Multiplier on how much departing guests move the house's renown, good or bad. The biggest gossip in the colony counts.

StatDef.label: care quality
StatDef.description: Multiplier on the quality of the massages this person gives.

StatDef.label: bank fees
StatDef.description: Multiplier on the bank's fees while this person lives in the colony. The lowest value counts.

StatDef.label: recruitment surcharge
StatDef.description: Multiplier on the goodwill surcharge above the floor of 5 when a guest joins the colony and this person won them over.

StatDef.label: tiredness while serving
StatDef.description: Multiplier on how fast rest drains while waiting tables or serving at a counter.

StatDef.label: guest generosity
StatDef.description: Multiplier on how much of their budget this person spends on one purchase as a guest.

StatDef.label: dish quality chance
StatDef.description: Chance to lift a cooked restaurant dish by one quality step.

StatDef.label: family cheer
StatDef.description: Added to the service score of children and families this person welcomes or shows around.

StatDef.label: price feel
StatDef.description: Added to how expensive guests find the prices when this person serves them.
